page.layout: Running head at top: "PARS SECVNDA", with page number "175" at the top right. Below it, two medallion portraits side by side, each with printed captions around the rim (left: F REX 44 and LVDOVICVS; right: FRANC. 25 and PHILIPPVS R.). Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs, full width. No marginal notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: D. LVDOVICVS post patrem Ludouicum octauum, Philippi secundi filium, apud Fracos regnat anno mundi 5188. à Christo nato 1226. huius mater Blancha rectrix testamento relicta, moderata & sapiens, partim obscuras, partim apertas inimicitias, initio regni exortas sedat, tum vi, tum beneuolētia cōcilians sibi principes, aliosque qui secesserant, facta in filium coiuratione. Innocetius quartus Fridericum metuens cum in Galliam fugisset, Lugduni concilium habuit, in quo ruber pileus & purpura primū Cardinal. data sunt. Spinea corona, & sacro-sancta Christi monimēta, q̄ Balduinus Venetis oppigneraue-rat, D. Ludouicus redemit: hæc apud sacrū palatij sacellū quod Lutetiæ erigebat, asseruanda cōmisit. Ad juvandas res Christia-nas cū ingēti exercitu in Asiam nauigauit: Aegyptū ingressus, Damiatā expugnauit. Christianos barbarorū seruos gregatim undique coges, redemit. Pastores, inges manus perditorū hominum, cū Regē captum esse audissent, arma capiūt, sed à Biturigibus, Aurelianensibúsque delentur. Robertus Regis frater, Lutetiæ Sorbonā instituit. Rex histriones & parasitos ab Aula exegit: Magistratuum ambitū coercuit: honorū dignitates non erāt tūc venales, nec ausi fuissent toto jurisdictionis tractu aut fundos emere, aut sacerdotia liberis accipere: blasphemis in fróte cauterium inussit. Rex in Africā traiecit, Carthaginē expugnauit, Tunetū obsedit: pestilentia grassante obiit ex profluuio anno regni 44. sepultus est in æde D. Diony. Gag. & Aem. lib. 7.

PHILIPPVS D. Ludouici filius, mortuo patre Rex in castris salutatur, postea Remis inungitur anno mundi 5232. à Christo nato 1270. Hoc Rege gesta sunt bella Flussatium, Hispanicum Castulonense, & Tarraconese. Siculi, die Paschæ, ingenti Gallorum cædefacta, à Carolo Regis patruo deficiunt. Obiit Rex Perpeniani, sepultus est in templo D. Dionysij.

page.notes: Medallion captions are printed inside the portraits; the left caption "F REX 44" and the right caption "FRANC. 25" are read from a small, curved scan and may be imprecise. Text reads "Innocetius" and "Balduinus" as printed (sic). "Tarraconese" and "cædefacta" are as printed. Two words are copied with the printed form despite possible error: "Christia-nas" (printed hyphen at line end) and "inussit" (printed "inussit").
